q: "He questioned softly why I failed." change this sentence into reported speech.
o: He questioned softly, “Why did you fail?"
He questioned softly, "Why did I fail?"
He told softly," Why have you failed?"
None of them
e: প্রদত্ত বাক্যটি আগে থেকেই reported (indirect) speech, তাই একে আবার reported speech করার প্রশ্ন ওঠে না; সে কারণে ‘None of them’ উত্তর ধরা হয়েছে। তবে প্রশ্নকর্তা যদি direct speech বোঝাতে চান, তাহলে (ক) ‘He questioned softly, “Why did you fail?”’ সবচেয়ে কাছাকাছি।
s: স্থানীয় সরকার প্রকৌশল অধিদপ্তর (এলজিইডি), কার্যসহকারী (১৪ জুলাই) (২০২৩)

q: He said, 'I went to Tangail.' (Indirect)
o: He said that had he gone to Tangail.
He said that I had gone to Tangail.
He said that he had gone to Tangail.
He said that he went to Tangail.
e:
Direct speech থেকে indirect করার সময় reporting verb past tense-এ থাকলে reported speech-এর tense এক ধাপ পিছিয়ে যায়। তাই past indefinite (went) বদলে past perfect (had gone) হয়। আর reported speech-এর I বদলে reporting verb-এর subject অনুযায়ী he হয়। ফলে বাক্যটি হয় 'He said that he had gone to Tangail.'
মনে রাখুন: present indefinite → past indefinite, present perfect → past perfect, will → would।

q: Find out the correct indirect form of the following direct sentence: Karim said, "I must go home."
o: Karim said that he will have to go home.
Karim said that he shall have to go home.
Karim said that he had to go home.
Karim said that he must go home
e: Reporting verb past tense হলে indirect speech এ বাধ্যবাধকতা অর্থের 'must' সাধারণত 'had to' হয়। তাই 'Karim said that he had to go home' সঠিক।
s: বাংলাদেশ জুডিশিয়াল সার্ভিস কমিশন, সহকারী জজ (৪র্থ বিজেএস প্রিলিমিনারি) (২০০৯)

q: She said to him, “I will call you as soon as possible.” Which of the following is correct indirect speech?
o: She told that she will call him as soon as possible
She told him she called him as soon as possible
She told him that she would call him as soon as possible
She told him she will call him as soon as possible
e: Said to him হলে indirect-এ told him বসে। Will বদলে would হয়, I বদলে she হয়, আর you বদলে হয় him (যাকে বলা হয়েছে)। তাই “She told him that she would call him as soon as possible” (সে তাকে বলল যত তাড়াতাড়ি সম্ভব ফোন করবে)। Told-এর পরে object ছাড়া ‘She told that’ চলে না, আর will বা called কাল ও অর্থ ঠিক রাখে না।

q: He said to her, "What a cold day!" The indirect speech of this:
o: He told her that it was a cold day.
He exclaimed that it was a cold day.
He exclaimed sorrowfully that it was a cold day.
He exclaimed that it was a very cold day.
e: বিস্ময়সূচক বাক্যকে indirect করতে said-এর জায়গায় exclaimed বসে, আর 'What a'-এর বদলে 'very' দিয়ে সাধারণ বাক্য হয়: it was a very cold day।

q: He said, “Good morning, Mr. Kamal.” Make it indirect speech.
o: He had wished Mr. Kamal good morning
He wished Mr. Kamal good morning
He said Mr. Kamal good morning
He told Mr. Kamal good morning
e: Good morning, Good evening, Good luck জাতীয় শুভেচ্ছা বা সম্ভাষণ indirect-এ wished দিয়ে প্রকাশ হয়, আর said/told বাদ যায়। কাঠামো: wished + person + good morning। সাধারণ অতীত অর্থে wished-ই বসে, had wished বসালে বেশি পুরোনো ঘটনা বোঝাত। তাই “He wished Mr. Kamal good morning” সঠিক। বাকি অপশনে say বা tell ব্যবহার করা ঠিক নয়।

q: Change the speech 'He said good morning Mr. Kamal'-
o: He said Mr. Kamal good morning
He told Mr. Kamal good morning
He wished Mr. Kamal good morning
He was wished Mr. Kamal good morning
e: Good morning, good night ইত্যাদি শুভেচ্ছাবাক্য indirect করতে reporting verb ‘said’ বদলে ‘wished’ বসে। তাই ‘He wished Mr. Kamal good morning’।
s: পল্লী উন্নয়ন ও সমবায় বিভাগ, জেলা সমন্বয়কারী (২০১৭)

q: Choose the correct indirect speech for the sentence— He said to me, "Let's go home."
o: He offered me to go home.
He told me that we have to go home.
He proposed to me that we should go home.
He said to me that let's go home.
e:
Direct speech-এ Let’s দিয়ে প্রস্তাব বোঝালে indirect speech-এ reporting verb বদলে propose বা suggest হয়, এরপর that বসে এবং reported speech-এ should ব্যবহার হয়। তাই He said to me, “Let’s go home” বাক্যের indirect রূপ হলো He proposed to me that we should go home।
মনে রাখুন:
Let’s ... বা Let us ... থাকলে said to-এর বদলে suggested বা proposed বসে।
একই নিয়মে: He said, “Let’s play.” = He suggested that they should play.

q: The indirect form of– He said, "Let me have some milk."—
o: He asked to have some milk
He wished that he might have some milk
He wanted to have some milk
He prayed to have some milk
e:
Direct speech-এ কেউ ইচ্ছা প্রকাশ করলে indirect speech-এ reporting verb said বদলে wished হয়। পরে that যোগ করে subject + might + verb বসে। ‘He said, “Let me have some milk”’ তাই পরোক্ষ উক্তিতে হয়: He wished that he might have some milk।
মনে রাখুন:
Blessing বা prayer থাকলে said → prayed।
Command হলে said → ordered/commanded।
Request হলে said → requested।
s: ফায়ার সার্ভিস ও সিভিল ডিফেন্স অধিদপ্তর, স্টাফ অফিসার (২০২৩)

q: Make indirect: The boy told the shopkeeper, 'Can you give me a candy please?'
o: The boy asked the shopkeeper if he can give him a candy?
The boy said please to the shopkeeper and to give him a candy?
They boy requested the shopkeeper if he could give him a candy?
The boy said to the shopkeeper if he can give him a candy
e: 'Please' থাকায় reporting verb হয় requested, প্রশ্নবোধক বাক্য বলে 'if' বসে, আর can হয় could; তাই গ সঠিক।
s: সম্মিলিত ৮ ব্যাংক ও আর্থিক প্রতিষ্ঠান, অফিসার (২৭ নভেম্বর) (২০২১)

q: He said, "tell me, boy, is the miller within?" বাক্যের সঠিক Indirect speech-
o: Addressing the boy, he asked him (boy) to tell him if the miller was within.
Addressing the boy, he said to him (boy) to tell him if the miller was within.
Addressing the boy, he asked him (boy) to tell him that the miller was within.
Addressing the boy, he said him (boy) to tell him if the miller was within.
e: সম্বোধনসূচক 'boy' থাকলে 'Addressing the boy' দিয়ে শুরু হয়। অনুরোধ/আদেশ অংশে asked ... to, আর প্রশ্নবোধক অংশে if বসে এবং is বদলে was হয়।

q: The indirect form of the sentence "She said, 'It must be pretty late. I really must go.'" should be:
o: She told it have been really late and she really must go.
She said it must be pretty late and she really must go.
She said she was very late and she had to go.
she said it was pretty late and she should really go.
e:
Direct speech-এ ‘must’ থাকলে indirect speech-এ সাধারণত তা অপরিবর্তিত থাকে। বিশেষ করে ‘It must be pretty late’ বাক্যে must মানে অনুমান, তাই indirect করলেও তা ঠিক থাকে। ফলে সঠিক রূপ হয়: She said it must be pretty late and she really must go।
বাক্যের অর্থ অপরিবর্তিত রাখতে হয়। অন্য অপশনগুলোতে ‘very late’ বা ‘should’ ব্যবহারে মূল কথার অর্থ বদলে গেছে, আর একটিতে ‘told’-এর ব্যবহারও ভুল।
মনে রাখুন: Would, could, should, might, ought to, must সাধারণত indirect speech-এ বদলায় না।

q: Change the narration: He remarked, 'two and two makes four'.
o: He remarked that two and two would make four
He remarked that two and two made four
He remarked that two and two makes four
He advised that two and two makes four
e: Reporting verb অতীত হলেও উদ্ধৃত অংশটি চিরন্তন সত্য হলে indirect speech-এ তার tense বদলায় না। তাই ‘makes’ অপরিবর্তিত থাকে।

q: He said to me , "Do you know me ?" ____ identify the correct indirect speech:
o: He asked me if I know him
He asked me if I knew him
He asked do I know him
He asked me if I knew him

q: Choose the indirect speech of the sentence : He said to me— "Thank you,"
o: He thanks you
He thanked you
He thanks you
He thanked me.
e:
Direct Speech: He said to me, “Thank you”। কথাটি Indirect করতে say to বদলে পরিবর্তিত ক্রিয়া বসে। এখানে ‘thank you’ ধন্যবাদ জানানো বোঝায়, তাই reporting verb হয় thanked। আর ‘you’ শ্রোতা অর্থাৎ ‘me’, তাই বাক্যটি দাঁড়ায়: He thanked me। বাকি অপশনের মধ্যে he thanks you ভুল, কারণ you আসলে me হবে।
মনে রাখুন:
Wish-এর ক্ষেত্রে: He said to me, “Good morning”। → He wished me good morning।
Exclamatory-তে: He exclaimed with joy that…

q: Choose the direct speech of the sentence: She told us to hurry.
o: She said, “Do hurry up.”
She said to us, “Hurry up.”
She told, “Hurry up.”
She said us, “Hurry up.”
e: Indirect-এ told + object থাকলে direct-এ said to + object বসে, আর আদেশ imperative আকারে উদ্ধৃতিতে আসে। Us শ্রোতা, তাই “She said to us, ‘Hurry up.’” সঠিক। Said-এর পরে object সরাসরি বসে না, ‘told’ সরাসরি উক্তির সাথে বেমানান, আর “Do hurry up” জোর দিয়ে বলার ধরন, যা মূল বাক্যে নেই।

q: She said to me, 'What do you want?' ____ the indirect speech is:
o: She said to me what I want.
She asked me what I want.
She asked me what I wanted.
She asked me what did I want.
e: Wh-প্রশ্নের indirect speech-এ said to বদলে asked হয়, প্রশ্ন assertive গঠনে যায় এবং present indefinite বদলে past indefinite হয়। তাই ‘She asked me what I wanted’।
s: শিক্ষা প্রকৌশল অধিদপ্তর, অফিস সহকারী কাম ক্যাশিয়ার/হিসাব সহকারী কাম ক্যাশিয়ার/স্টোর কিপার (২০২১)

q: He addressed Mr. Rahman and wished him good morning - বাক্যটির direct speech হবে-
o: He said to Mr. Rahman, Good morning.
He said, ‘Good morning, Mr. Rahman.’
He said, ‘Good morning. to Mr. Rahman.’
He bade good morning to Mr. Rahman
e: indirect speech-এ ‘addressed’ থাকলে বোঝায় সম্বোধন করা হয়েছে; direct speech-এ সেই ব্যক্তির নাম উদ্ধৃতির ভেতরে সম্বোধন হিসেবে বসে: He said, ‘Good morning, Mr. Rahman.’
s: প্রাথমিক শিক্ষা অধিদপ্তর, সহকারী শিক্ষক (৪র্থ ধাপ, সেট ৮৪৩৩) (২০১৯)

q: "He asked me when the next letter would come." বাক্যের direct speech হচ্ছে-
o: He said to me,"When would the next letter come?"
He asked me,"When will the next letter come ?"
He said to me,"When will the next letter come?"
He said to me,"When the next letter will come?"
e: Direct speech-এ asked বদলে said to হয়, would বদলে will হয় এবং প্রশ্নটি প্রশ্নবোধক ক্রমে (When will …?) বসে।
s: প্রাথমিক শিক্ষা অধিদপ্তর, প্রাক-প্রাথমিক সহকারী শিক্ষক (আলফা) (২০১৪)

q: The indirect form of the sentence 'She said to him, 'I don't believe you' should be -
o: She told him that she did not believe him.
She said to him that she had not believed him.
She said she did not believe him.
She said to him that she never believed him.
e: Reporting verb 'said to' থাকলে indirect-এ 'told' হয়। present tense 'don't believe' অতীতে গিয়ে 'did not believe' হয়, আর I → she, you → him হয়।
